about: Sentence Scramble sentences per level. The game shows the words as shuffled tiles (commas and the end mark hidden; the first word in lower case unless keepCap is true). M.1: 5-7 words, past simple. M.2: 8-10 words, past continuous and linking words. M.3: 11-14 words, relative clauses and conditionals. Written for Kru. At least 50 per level, shuffled every game.

intro.title: Sentence Scramble
text: The words of a sentence are mixed up.
Put them in the right order!

intro.title: Write it on paper
text: Write the whole sentence: capital letter and full stop.

intro.title: Be fast!
text: Hold up your paper when you finish.
The first three correct teams win points.
